questions.text: Outline any concerns regarding the impact of the Acquisition on competition, including if the Estia and AnglicareSA facilities in South Australia are close competitors and there are not many alternatives.
Provide any additional information or comments that you consider relevant to the ACCC’s assessment of the Acquisition.
Provide a brief description of your business or organisation, including any commercial relationships with Estia and/or AnglicareSA.

questions.section: Questions for operators of residential aged care homes
questions.text: Identify the residential aged care homes you operate that are located within metropolitan Adelaide or its outer suburbs and their location.

questions.section: Questions for operators of residential aged care homes
questions.text: Identify the characteristics of your residential aged care homes listed in response to question 4 that you consider are most important in attracting new residents (e.g. pricing, staff/patient ratios, the variety or quality of service offerings, the quality of physical facilities including frequency of upgrades, any religious affiliation, etc.).

questions.section: Questions for operators of residential aged care homes
questions.text: To what extent do you compete with Estia and/or Anglicare in the supply of residential aged care services in metropolitan Adelaide or its outer suburbs? If possible, provide estimated market shares.

questions.section: Questions for operators of residential aged care homes
questions.text: Identify the characteristics of AnglicareSA’s residential aged care homes that you consider are most important in attracting new residents (e.g. its Anglican religious affiliation, pricing, staff/patient ratios, the variety or quality of service offerings, the quality of physical facilities including frequency of upgrades, etc.).
